_note: SYNTHETIC stakeholder database for the Environmental Charity Bazaar demo. Every record is fabricated and structurally representative — no real donor, parent, phone number, address, or payment record. Roles / interests / communication preferences may be used for respectful, non-pressuring outreach; occupation / business / board position / prior-donation amount must NEVER be used to infer wealth, rank donors, or apply pressure.

stakeholders.suggested_outreach_type: Invite to attend and optionally sponsor drinks or coupon booklets
allowed_use: Mention event purpose and transparent use of funds
prohibited_use: Ask for a larger donation because of occupation
Suggest that past support creates an obligation
